description: This file provides utility functions for verifying the resolution of a specific API endpoint (/api/users) with respect to organization IDs, mainly for development or testing purposes. It constructs URLs based on config and auth tokens, logs information in non-production environments, and includes helper functions to facilitate quick testing.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the URL for the /api/users endpoint, optionally simulating a specific organization ID, and performs validation of query parameters in development environment.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: A helper function that calls verifyUsersUrlResolution with a predefined organization ID ('T0015') for quick manual verification during development.
